# gap ratio by character ORDER/CONDUCTOR, sync full-group data Q=9,27,81 (s=0)
import csv,math
def analyze(path,Q,scol="0.0000"):
    phi=Q-Q//3
    rows=[]
    for line in open(path):
        if line.startswith('#') or line.startswith('Q,L'): continue
        f=line.strip().split(',')
        if len(f)<17 or f[5]=='trivial' or f[4]!=scol: continue
        k=int(f[6]); ratio=float(f[16])
        order=phi//math.gcd(k,phi)
        # conductor 3^c: order=2*3^j or 3^j -> c=j+1 ; compute via order's 3-part
        o=order; j=0
        while o%3==0: o//=3; j+=1
        cond=3**(j+1)
        rows.append((k,order,cond,ratio))
    # worst (max ratio) per conductor
    bycond={}
    for k,o,c,r in rows:
        bycond.setdefault(c,[]).append(r)
    print(f"Q={Q} (phi={phi}), s=0:  max gap_ratio by character conductor:")
    for c in sorted(bycond):
        print(f"   conductor {c:>5}: max ratio={max(bycond[c]):.4f}  (n={len(bycond[c])})")
analyze("c_suite/out_kappa/spectral_gaps.csv",9)
